derivations.quote: Let $u,v$ be the exact stored forward outputs and $\widetilde u,\widetilde v$ the returned ones, all disk arrays. By bilinearity, $P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v)-P(u,v)=P(\widetilde u-u,\widetilde v)+P(u,\widetilde v-v)$. By the contraction bound for $P$, and norm at most $1$ of $\widetilde v$ and $u$, each term is less than $\delta$, so $\|P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v)-P(u,v)\|_\infty<2\delta$. With $\widetilde z=Q_p(P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v))$ and $z_*=P(u,v)$, truncation gives $\|\widetilde z-z_*\|_\infty<2\delta+\eta$, and $\widetilde z$ is a disk grid array. The opposite procedure returns $\widetilde h$ with $\|\widetilde h-\mathcal T_+\widetilde z\|_\infty<\delta$, and $\|\mathcal T_+(\widetilde z-z_*)\|_\infty\le\|\widetilde z-z_*\|_\infty$ since $\mathcal T_+$ is a contraction. The triangle inequality gives $\|\widetilde h-\mathcal T_+z_*\|_\infty<3\delta+\eta$. The exact multiplication by $M$ gives total error less than $M(3\delta+\eta)=\sqrt2\,M(3\ell+1)2^{-p}$

symbols.name: number of records
symbols.meaning: The number of polynomial records, one per cyclic address of the remaining axes.
symbols.quote: Let $M=\prod_i t_i$ be the number of records, $T=rM$ the number of complex coefficients, and $*$ cyclic convolution.

symbols.name: number of coefficients
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients in an array, T = rM.
symbols.quote: Let $M=\prod_i t_i$ be the number of records, $T=rM$ the number of complex coefficients, and $*$ cyclic convolution.

symbols.name: forward transform
symbols.quote: Let $F^-$, $F^+$ be the forward and opposite synthetic transforms.

symbols.name: opposite transform
symbols.quote: Let $F^-$, $F^+$ be the forward and opposite synthetic transforms.

symbols.name: pointwise product
symbols.meaning: The pointwise product of records, P(u,v) = uv/r.

symbols.name: layout permutation
symbols.meaning: The permutation of records produced by the tape layout.
symbols.quote: Perform both forward transforms and retain their common $LB$ order, with $L$ the layout permutation of records and $B$ the bit-reversal order.

symbols.name: bit-reversal order
symbols.meaning: The bit-reversal order in which forward outputs are written.
symbols.quote: Perform both forward transforms and retain their common $LB$ order, with $L$ the layout permutation of records and $B$ the bit-reversal order.

symbols.name: opposite map
symbols.meaning: The exact counterpart F^+ B^{-1} L^{-1} of the opposite procedure.
symbols.quote: Their exact counterparts are $LBF^-$ and the opposite map $\mathcal T_+=F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}$; permuting records preserves the norm, so $\mathcal T_+$ is a contraction.

symbols.name: log of record length
symbols.meaning: The base-2 logarithm of the record length r.
symbols.quote: With $\ell=\log_2r$, each procedure maps disk grid arrays to disk grid arrays with error less than $\delta=\sqrt2\ell\,2^{-p}$

symbols.name: transform error
symbols.meaning: The error bound sqrt2 * l * 2^{-p} of each forward or opposite procedure.
symbols.quote: With $\ell=\log_2r$, each procedure maps disk grid arrays to disk grid arrays with error less than $\delta=\sqrt2\ell\,2^{-p}$

symbols.name: truncation error
symbols.meaning: The error bound sqrt2 * 2^{-p} for one truncation.
symbols.quote: truncated by $Q_p$ to $p$ bits of precision, which changes it by less than $\eta=\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ without raising the norm

symbols.name: layout chunk width
symbols.meaning: The width of the address chunks used by the tape layout.
symbols.quote: Each transform, and the final linear scaling, costs $O(Tp[dK+pK^{\tau-1}+\ell d^{\lambda'}])$, with $K$ the layout chunk width and $\tau,\lambda'$ exponents from the cost lemma.

relations.quote: The transforms are laid out as in [Tape layout for synthetic transforms](transform-layout.md).

Each record product is formed by [Signed packing](signed-packing.md) in $O(rp\log(rp))$ time, truncated by $Q_p$ to $p$ bits of precision, which changes it by less than $\eta=\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ without raising the norm.
The procedure keeps the retained order of [Retained frequency order](frequency-order.md), passing the product to the opposite transform without reordering.
